import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    if k == 0:
        result = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
    elif k == 1:
        result = pow(p, p, MOD)
    else:
        current = k
        order = 1
        while current != 1:
            current = (current * k) % p
            order += 1
        result = pow(p, (p - 1) // order, MOD)

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
